contract: Read-only Microsoft Graph Teams history acquisition from the signed-in customer represented by a named credential. Verify /me against the configured owner before discovering chats, joined teams and channels. Follow bounded same-origin Graph continuation URLs and persist stable chat/channel/reply provenance, edits, deletions, attachment references and unambiguous existing-person links in the canonical communications database. Never send Teams content.
acceptance: Verified signed-in Microsoft identity precedes all history reads and owner mismatch records failure without acquiring messages
Actual Graph REST chat, team, channel and message endpoints use bearer authorization with bounded same-origin pagination
Conversation-scoped provenance prevents cross-chat message ID collisions and replay updates edits without duplicates
Existing people link only through an explicit Microsoft Graph identity handle; ambiguous or absent identity remains unlinked
HTTP 401/403 records revoked state, other transport/provider failures record failed state, and no token is persisted
Real HTTP service, persistence, handler and console source/sync/error journeys are independently asserted
limits: Live Microsoft tenant qualification requires a customer-granted delegated Graph token and is separate from local protocol qualification.
History is bounded to 40 pages and 1000 normalized messages per sync; bounded results are labeled partial.
Person linking requires an existing handle identity formatted microsoft:<Graph user id>; Gideon does not auto-create people from tenant directory data.
Channel expanded reply continuation beyond the returned replies collection is not yet acquired.
